query:
SELECT i.id, i.created_at, i.client_name, i.status, v.name as vessel_name 
FROM inspections i 
JOIN vessels v ON i.vessel_id = v.id 
WHERE i.status = 'rejected' 
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC 
LIMIT 10;
